execution: Read-only source/artifact inventory; no commands built or ran benchmark code.
answer: The deterministic-only PR bench does execute six qlever-synthetic count queries while collecting load-layout metrics, but it exits before the separate 28-query operator-coverage block. It therefore supplies some real query execution, not the registered operator-coverage suite.

evidence.fact: Q points to bench/qlever-synthetic/queries; DET_ONLY calls CLI bench with Q in count mode three times (normal, compressed, smaller fixed corpus), emits metrics and exits0. OPQ count/materialize/json loop occurs later and cannot be reached.
Builds CLI and generator; PR event uses --deterministic-only. Non-PR full-script route can reach operator loop, subject to earlier commands succeeding; no actual run verified here.
Change-triggered re-evaluation expectation includes operator-coverage; enforcement column identifies E conformance ratchet, not a separate hard operator latency gate.
Query execution/operator checklist asks for operator-coverage bench plus conformance and builtin error table.
Registered operator-coverage uses generated2000 entities,28 query files,3 iterations in count/materialize/json; timing is trend-only, not deterministic perf-gate.
--only operator-coverage exists, but requires prebuilt CLI/generator; it does not silently build absent binaries. Direct per-suite command is generator dump2000 then three modes.

run_query_suite routes graph forms to construct_or_describe; other modes dispatch count/query/query_json. A query error prints ERROR and runner continues; stdout/JSON must be checked, exit0 alone insufficient. JSON mode rows denotes output byte count, not solution count.

narrowest_complete_existing_route.build_prerequisite: cargo build --release -p sparq-cli -p sparq-bench (actual workflow command; scope limited to two binaries, but transitive dependencies are not all warm)
once_built: for mode in count materialize json; do "$CLI" bench "$SCRATCH/op.nt" ntriples bench/operators/queries 3 "$mode"; done
narrowest_complete_existing_route.evidence: Exact source/compiler/features/binary hashes; generated dataset hash; full stdout/stderr for each mode; exactly28 named non-ERROR rows per mode (84 total), and no missing/failed queries. Do not equate JSON byte counts with count/materialize row counts. Timing is local advisory; no admission speedup or automated ratchet claim.
narrowest_complete_existing_route.recommended_scope: Only the registered operator suite, not ci-bench.sh full or run-all-benchmarks without --only. Do not use ||true or discard ERROR rows for validation.

current_footprint.warm: Current engine/core/common default+test-feature artifacts in O3/unwind/noLTO/codegen16. Repository shipping release uses fatLTO/codegen1/abort and would not match those profiles.
current_footprint.constraint: Cannot truthfully promise the full two-bin default-feature build fits the remaining512MiB allowance from this source-only inventory. No byte/time estimate manufactured; requires explicit bounded build feasibility decision. Avoid starting a default fat-LTO build as a supposedly cheap check.

smaller_existing_partial_check.scope: Registered existing28-query corpus,200entities,iters2; real query for SELECT/ASK and construct_or_describe for graph forms. Dependencies only core,engine,rayon; no CLI/generator/Oxigraph. ThinLTO profile differs from warm noLTO and detached lock/provenance has not been assessed.
smaller_existing_partial_check.limitations: Only public query/materialized and graph-form paths, not count/json. Smoke performs one measured iteration after warmup, so it cannot prove repeat-allocation determinism; alloc output is unrelated to the current correctness obligation. Useful smaller corpus smoke if specifically authorized, not full three-mode template fulfillment and no new allocator/performance campaign recommended.

recommendation: Do not mark operator-coverage completed from PR deterministic metrics. Keep template item pending; prefer the one registered2000-entity/three-mode suite using correctly sourced CLI/generator if already available on an authorized runner, or after a separately bounded local two-bin build feasibility decision. No workflow change, dispatch, threshold change or broad campaign needed. Existing full CI conformance remains the automated semantic ratchet.
